scenarios.name: Keep two selected staged commands in order when moving down

background_steps.name: the MCAD Software starts with a writable copy of `fixtures/preferences/ribbon-normal` as its configuration directory

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is open and active in the MCAD Software
a part is active in the MCAD Software
the Ribbon customization dialog shows an initially empty Part Tools target
the user has staged these commands in order:
the user selects "2-D Drawing" and extends the selection down to "2D Sketches"
the user clicks the down ordering button
the custom panel list remains in this order:
the first two rows remain selected
no User Commands panel is visible on the Tools ribbon
